segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, so for Cedar Valley, I’m sending the 48-seat quote this afternoon. They asked for June 1 go-live, net 30, and the two-hour admin training bundled in.

segments.speaker: Leo
segments.text: That tracks. Did you keep the services line at $3,200? Their ops lead was fine with that as long as it’s on the first invoice, not split.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yep, one invoice. Subscription is $28,560 annual, services $3,200, taxes separate. I used the standard order form language, no weird terms.

segments.speaker: Leo
segments.text: Good. Only thing, while I had the account list open, Harbor Mills is still showing through 10/31, and I don’t think we’ve had a customer thread since that AP question in August.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Mm, yeah. Okay. For Cedar, procurement wanted to know if support is 8 to 6 Central or their local time.

segments.speaker: Leo
segments.text: It’s 8 to 6 Central. I’d spell that out because they’ve got managers in Arizona and Ohio.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Will do. Also they want the billing contact as Dana Kim, not the original signer. Same legal entity, just different email for invoices.

segments.speaker: Leo
segments.text: Fine. If they sign by Friday, implementation can still hold the June 1 slot. After that it probably pushes to June 10.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: I’ll put that in the email, not as a threat, just plain. Anything else before I send?

segments.speaker: Leo
segments.text: No, looks clean. Copy me and I’ll watch for the onboarding questions.
